TEST_USB_AMMETER_CURRENT_DRAW.name: USB Power Delivery / Ammeter Current Draw Measurement
TEST_USB_AMMETER_CURRENT_DRAW.purpose: Measures baseline VBUS charging current negotiation to differentiate port/sub-board physical disconnects from PMIC faults and battery degradation.
prerequisites: External calibrated 5V/9V digital USB meter connected
Known-good OEM USB-C or Lightning cable
Battery connected to logic board
safety_precautions: Do not connect unregulated DC voltage above 5.2V unless PD protocol negotiation is confirmed
TEST_USB_AMMETER_CURRENT_DRAW.procedure: Connect phone to 5V/9V digital USB meter. Observe initial current handshake.
TEST_USB_AMMETER_CURRENT_DRAW.fail_condition: 0.000A draw (open line / blown fuse) or < 0.150A (fake charge / dead PMIC).

expected_observations.PASS: 0.90A - 2.20A stable fast-charge negotiation. Confirms intact port, sub-board, and PMIC handshake.
expected_observations.FAIL: 0.000A dead open circuit or < 0.150A fake charging draw indicating port or PMIC fault.
expected_observations.INCONCLUSIVE: Current fluctuates randomly without settling on stable handshake.
expected_observations.NOT_PERFORMED: Ammeter test skipped or equipment unavailable.

TEST_USB_AMMETER_CURRENT_DRAW.rule_reference: IEEE 1725 / USB-IF Power Delivery Compliance Standard §4.2

TEST_CHARGING_PORT_MICROSCOPE_PIN_CHECK.name: Microscope Visual Inspection of Charging Port Pins
TEST_CHARGING_PORT_MICROSCOPE_PIN_CHECK.purpose: Verifies mechanical integrity of connector pins to distinguish external debris/physical damage from motherboard-level PMIC defects.
prerequisites: Device powered down
Proper ring LED illumination positioned inside port cavity
safety_precautions: Do not insert metal probes into energized port to avoid shorting VBUS to ground
TEST_CHARGING_PORT_MICROSCOPE_PIN_CHECK.procedure: Inspect CC1/CC2, VBUS, D+, D-, and GND spring contacts for corrosion, bent pins, or lint obstruction.
TEST_CHARGING_PORT_MICROSCOPE_PIN_CHECK.expected_reading: Straight, clean gold-plated spring contacts with zero foreign debris.
TEST_CHARGING_PORT_MICROSCOPE_PIN_CHECK.fail_condition: Bent/broken spring contacts or black carbon/oxide deposits.

expected_observations.PASS: Gold pins clean, straight, and properly aligned. Rules out mechanical port connector obstruction.
expected_observations.FAIL: Bent, broken, recessed, or burnt carbonized pins clearly visible under optical magnification.
expected_observations.INCONCLUSIVE: Obstruction cannot be fully assessed without chemical clearing.

TEST_SUB_BOARD_FLEX_CONTINUITY.name: Sub-Board Interconnect Flex Cable Continuity Test
TEST_SUB_BOARD_FLEX_CONTINUITY.purpose: Directly isolates mechanical failure of the drop-impacted sub-board flex cable from main logic board charging IC failure.
prerequisites: Back housing opened
Interconnect FPC connector unseated from motherboard
safety_precautions: Disconnect battery prior to probing FPC connector contacts to prevent ESD discharge
TEST_SUB_BOARD_FLEX_CONTINUITY.procedure: Probe test points on sub-board and corresponding pins on mainboard FPC connector.
TEST_SUB_BOARD_FLEX_CONTINUITY.fail_condition: Infinite resistance (OL) indicating severed trace in flexible cable.

expected_observations.PASS: Clean continuity (< 1.5 Ohms) across all VBUS and GND traces. Proves flex cable is fully intact.
expected_observations.FAIL: Open loop (OL) on VBUS or CC lines confirming fractured flex ribbon trace from drop impact.
expected_observations.INCONCLUSIVE: Intermittent resistance fluctuation during cable flexing.

TEST_SUB_BOARD_FLEX_CONTINUITY.rule_reference: Samsung & Android Modular Hardware Architecture Repair Guide §2.1

TEST_DIODE_MODE_VBUS_LINE.name: Diode Mode Value Test on VBUS / Primary Charging Rail
TEST_DIODE_MODE_VBUS_LINE.tool_required: Digital Multimeter in Diode Mode (Red probe to Ground, Black probe to Test Point)
TEST_DIODE_MODE_VBUS_LINE.purpose: Measures junction voltage drop of silicon protection diodes and PMIC input stage to detect shorted or blown charging ICs.
prerequisites: Battery completely disconnected
Multimeter red probe securely clipped to logic board ground shield
safety_precautions: Never measure diode mode while battery or USB power is connected; will damage multimeter
TEST_DIODE_MODE_VBUS_LINE.procedure: Place Red probe on motherboard ground shield. Place Black probe on VBUS test point / capacitor.
TEST_DIODE_MODE_VBUS_LINE.fail_condition: 0.000V (dead short to ground) or OL (broken trace / open filter).

expected_observations.PASS: Diode reading between 0.450V and 0.650V. Proves VBUS input silicon path and ESD diodes are normal.
expected_observations.FAIL: 0.000V dead short or open line OL, confirming internal PMIC semiconductor junction breakdown.
expected_observations.INCONCLUSIVE: Reading drifts out of normal range (e.g. 0.220V) without dead short.

TEST_DIODE_MODE_VBUS_LINE.rule_reference: Micro-soldering Diagnostic Handbook / Tristar-Hydra VBUS Specification v3

TEST_THERMAL_CAMERA_BOARD_SWEEP.name: Thermal Imaging Camera Power Rail Fault Localization
TEST_THERMAL_CAMERA_BOARD_SWEEP.tool_required: Infrared Thermal Camera (InfiRay / Seek Thermal / QianLi)
TEST_THERMAL_CAMERA_BOARD_SWEEP.purpose: Identifies exact shorted decoupling capacitor or degraded PMIC silicon die through differential thermal gradient under controlled voltage injection.
prerequisites: DC power supply current limit set to 1.5A maximum at 3.8V - 4.2V
Motherboard shield cans removed
safety_precautions: Do not inject voltage higher than nominal rail rating (1.8V lines will be destroyed if 4V injected)
TEST_THERMAL_CAMERA_BOARD_SWEEP.procedure: Inject 3.8V - 4.2V current-limited (1.5A) to battery rail and observe thermal heatmap hotspot.
TEST_THERMAL_CAMERA_BOARD_SWEEP.expected_reading: Ambient temperature (< 35°C) across all components on standby.
TEST_THERMAL_CAMERA_BOARD_SWEEP.fail_condition: Single capacitor or IC rapidly spikes to > 65°C - 100°C within 3 seconds.

expected_observations.PASS: Thermal profile uniform and cool; no concentrated thermal hotspot detected.
expected_observations.FAIL: Clear thermal hotspot (> 65°C) pinpointing shorted capacitor or failing PMIC.
expected_observations.INCONCLUSIVE: Diffuse warmth across multiple power inductors without single localized point.

TEST_THERMAL_CAMERA_BOARD_SWEEP.rule_reference: IPC-7711/7721 Rework, Modification and Repair of Electronic Assemblies §3.4

TEST_BATTERY_INTERNAL_RESISTANCE_AND_CYC.name: Battery Cell Health & Internal Resistance Analysis
TEST_BATTERY_INTERNAL_RESISTANCE_AND_CYC.tool_required: Battery Diagnostic Tool (i2C / JCID / QianLi) or Multimeter
TEST_BATTERY_INTERNAL_RESISTANCE_AND_CYC.purpose: Measures electrochemical impedance and cycle count to establish whether battery degradation is the primary cause of drain or boot-looping.
prerequisites: Battery uncoupled from motherboard
Diagnostic box calibrated
safety_precautions: Inspect pouch for mechanical punctures before connecting to battery test box
TEST_BATTERY_INTERNAL_RESISTANCE_AND_CYC.procedure: Connect battery flex to test box or measure terminal voltage under 1A load.
TEST_BATTERY_INTERNAL_RESISTANCE_AND_CYC.expected_reading: > 80% maximum capacity, < 500 charge cycles, internal resistance < 45mΩ.

expected_observations.PASS: Health > 85%, cycle count < 400, internal resistance < 45mΩ. Confirms healthy battery cell.
expected_observations.FAIL: Health < 75% or resistance > 90mΩ. Confirms cell chemical exhaustion requiring replacement.

TEST_BATTERY_INTERNAL_RESISTANCE_AND_CYC.rule_reference: UL 1642 Standard for Lithium Batteries / OEM Battery Health Specs

TEST_BATTERY_VOLTAGE_LOAD_DROP.name: Battery Open-Circuit vs Load Voltage Drop Test
TEST_BATTERY_VOLTAGE_LOAD_DROP.purpose: Monitors voltage sag during CPU boot current spikes to detect high internal battery impedance causing sudden shutdowns.
prerequisites: Battery charged to at least 3.7V resting
Multimeter probes attached to battery terminal pads
safety_precautions: Avoid shorting positive and negative battery terminals with meter probes
TEST_BATTERY_VOLTAGE_LOAD_DROP.procedure: Measure battery terminal voltage resting, then attempt boot.
TEST_BATTERY_VOLTAGE_LOAD_DROP.expected_reading: Resting 3.8V - 4.2V; voltage drop during boot should not drop below 3.6V.
TEST_BATTERY_VOLTAGE_LOAD_DROP.fail_condition: Terminal voltage instantly collapses below 3.2V when boot initiated.

expected_observations.PASS: Voltage maintains > 3.65V throughout boot sequence. Proves cell delivers required peak current.
expected_observations.FAIL: Voltage drops sharply below 3.20V under boot load, causing instantaneous undervoltage cutoff.
expected_observations.INCONCLUSIVE: Voltage fluctuates without triggering full boot cycle.

TEST_BATTERY_VOLTAGE_LOAD_DROP.rule_reference: IEC 62133 Secondary Cells and Batteries Electrical Safety Standard

TEST_PHYSICAL_BATTERY_DIMENSION_CHECK.name: Battery Physical Thickness & Outgassing Swell Inspection
TEST_PHYSICAL_BATTERY_DIMENSION_CHECK.purpose: Verifies whether chemical outgassing has caused dangerous pouch expansion threatening display lift or thermal runaway.
prerequisites: Back cover removed
Battery pouch exposed
safety_precautions: CRITICAL: Do NOT press, pierce, or bend swollen battery. Prepare fireproof safety container.
TEST_PHYSICAL_BATTERY_DIMENSION_CHECK.procedure: Inspect lithium pouch on flat marble surface for pillowing or expansion.
TEST_PHYSICAL_BATTERY_DIMENSION_CHECK.expected_reading: Completely flat pouch (< 4.2mm OEM standard thickness).
TEST_PHYSICAL_BATTERY_DIMENSION_CHECK.fail_condition: Pouch is rounded or thicker than 4.8mm, or soft sponge-like texture.

expected_observations.PASS: Pouch is flat, uniform, and < 4.2mm thickness. No swelling or delamination.
expected_observations.FAIL: Lithium cell visibly bloated > 4.8mm with pillowing and spongy texture. High safety hazard.
expected_observations.INCONCLUSIVE: Slight expansion cannot be verified without caliper measurement.

TEST_PHYSICAL_BATTERY_DIMENSION_CHECK.rule_reference: UN 38.3 Lithium Battery Safety Transport and Inspection Specification

TEST_MICROSCOPE_CORROSION_INSPECTION.name: Full Motherboard Optical Microscope Corrosion Sweep
TEST_MICROSCOPE_CORROSION_INSPECTION.tool_required: Stereo Microscope with Ring LED Light
TEST_MICROSCOPE_CORROSION_INSPECTION.purpose: Detects galvanic corrosion, green copper carbonate, and dendritic bridges under BGA packages and connectors.
prerequisites: All RF shielding cans removed
Board cleaned of dust and surface lint
safety_precautions: ESD grounding strap required during board inspection
TEST_MICROSCOPE_CORROSION_INSPECTION.procedure: Inspect under-fill borders, shield perimeters, and filter capacitor arrays for salt crusting.
TEST_MICROSCOPE_CORROSION_INSPECTION.expected_reading: Clean solder joints with bright metallic silver luster.
TEST_MICROSCOPE_CORROSION_INSPECTION.fail_condition: Green copper carbonate or white crusty lead-tin oxide deposits.

expected_observations.PASS: Zero corrosion or mineral deposit. All joints clean and shiny. Rules out liquid ingress.
expected_observations.FAIL: Clear green copper carbonate or white oxide deposits bridging SMD components.
expected_observations.INCONCLUSIVE: Minor flux residue without definitive evidence of liquid ingress.

TEST_MICROSCOPE_CORROSION_INSPECTION.rule_reference: IPC/WHMA-A-620 Requirements and Acceptance for Cable and Harness Assemblies §13

TEST_DIODE_MODE_MAIN_POWER_RAILS.name: Diode Mode Measurement of Primary Motherboard Power Rails
TEST_DIODE_MODE_MAIN_POWER_RAILS.purpose: Measures junction drops on VDD_MAIN, VBAT, and 1.8V rails to locate low-impedance leaks or complete shorts to ground.
prerequisites: Battery completely unplugged
Board discharged to 0V
safety_precautions: Verify zero residual capacitor voltage before touching probes to avoid meter overload
TEST_DIODE_MODE_MAIN_POWER_RAILS.procedure: Measure diode drop to ground on VDD_MAIN, VBAT, 1.8V_IO, and S2_REG rails.
TEST_DIODE_MODE_MAIN_POWER_RAILS.fail_condition: Any rail showing < 0.050V (low impedance leak) or 0.000V (dead short).

expected_observations.PASS: All main power rails show normal silicon diode drop (0.350V - 0.520V). No short to ground.
expected_observations.FAIL: Primary rail reads 0.000V or < 0.050V to ground, proving hard short circuit on main rail.
expected_observations.INCONCLUSIVE: Reading is borderline (e.g. 0.280V) suggesting partial semiconductor degradation.

TEST_DIODE_MODE_MAIN_POWER_RAILS.rule_reference: Mobile Board Repair Standard Diode Mapping & Bus Fault Diagnostics v4.1

TEST_ULTRASONIC_CLEANING_AND_BAKING.name: Ultrasonic Chemical De-oxidation & Dehydration
TEST_ULTRASONIC_CLEANING_AND_BAKING.tool_required: Industrial Ultrasonic Cleaner + PCB Drying Oven
TEST_ULTRASONIC_CLEANING_AND_BAKING.purpose: Cleans microscopic conductive salts beneath BGA under-fills and evaporates trapped moisture.
prerequisites: All modular cameras, microphones, and screens detached from logic board
Logic board submerged in pure electronics-grade IPA
safety_precautions: Operate ultrasonic tank only in well-ventilated area away from open flame or spark sources
TEST_ULTRASONIC_CLEANING_AND_BAKING.procedure: Immerse stripped logic board in pure electronics-grade IPA at 40kHz, followed by 60°C dry cycle.
TEST_ULTRASONIC_CLEANING_AND_BAKING.expected_reading: 100% dry board with no flux or oxidation residue under BGA components.
TEST_ULTRASONIC_CLEANING_AND_BAKING.fail_condition: Moisture residue remaining under shield cavities.

expected_observations.PASS: Board completely de-oxidized and desiccated. Power rail impedance normalized.
expected_observations.FAIL: Persistent residual oxidation bridges under un-fill or dead IC silicon.
expected_observations.INCONCLUSIVE: Board clean but post-clean diode mode indicates unresolved IC failure.

TEST_ULTRASONIC_CLEANING_AND_BAKING.rule_reference: IPC-CH-65B Guidelines for Cleaning of Printed Boards and Assemblies §5

TEST_EXTERNAL_KNOWN_GOOD_DISPLAY.name: Known-Good OEM Test Display Assembly Substitution
TEST_EXTERNAL_KNOWN_GOOD_DISPLAY.purpose: Directly separates screen assembly damage (shattered matrix, cracked digitizer) from motherboard display driver or GPU failure.
prerequisites: Known-working verified OEM test screen compatible with model
Original display flex unplugged
safety_precautions: Always disconnect battery before attaching or detaching display flex to prevent blowing backlight fuse
TEST_EXTERNAL_KNOWN_GOOD_DISPLAY.procedure: Connect known-working OEM display panel flex directly to board without adhering.
TEST_EXTERNAL_KNOWN_GOOD_DISPLAY.expected_reading: Crisp display illumination, accurate color calibration, responsive 10-finger touch.
TEST_EXTERNAL_KNOWN_GOOD_DISPLAY.fail_condition: Same visual fault persists with known-good display (proves motherboard driver fault).

expected_observations.PASS: Known-good display lights up perfectly with touch working. Confirms fault is entirely in original display.
expected_observations.FAIL: Known-good display also stays completely black or glitched. Proves fault is on logic board driver.
expected_observations.INCONCLUSIVE: Display backlight lights up but image remains corrupted.

TEST_EXTERNAL_KNOWN_GOOD_DISPLAY.rule_reference: Apple & Android Display Diagnostics & Module Substitution Protocol v2

TEST_CURRENT_DRAW_BOOT_VIBRATION.name: Blind Boot Vibration & Current Cycle Confirmation
TEST_CURRENT_DRAW_BOOT_VIBRATION.tool_required: DC Power Supply with Analog/Digital Ammeter
TEST_CURRENT_DRAW_BOOT_VIBRATION.purpose: Confirms phone logic board is successfully booting and alive despite completely black screen.
prerequisites: Battery connected or DC power supply attached to battery terminal
safety_precautions: Ensure DC voltage does not exceed 4.2V
TEST_CURRENT_DRAW_BOOT_VIBRATION.procedure: Power phone via DC supply and observe boot current waveform (0 -> 150mA -> 800mA -> 1.5A).
TEST_CURRENT_DRAW_BOOT_VIBRATION.expected_reading: Standard boot stepping current with haptic vibration confirmation.
TEST_CURRENT_DRAW_BOOT_VIBRATION.fail_condition: Current freezes at fixed value or loops cyclically.

expected_observations.PASS: Haptic motor pulses, boot sound chimes, and current steps dynamically to 1.2A. Phone is fully alive.
expected_observations.FAIL: No vibration, no dynamic stepping; ammeter reads 0mA or freezes at fixed low current.
expected_observations.INCONCLUSIVE: Intermittent vibration without steady current draw.

TEST_CURRENT_DRAW_BOOT_VIBRATION.rule_reference: Smartphone Logic Board Power-Up State Machine Standard §3

TEST_FLASHLIGHT_IMAGE_REFLECTION_CHECK.name: Angled Flashlight LCD Matrix Visual Inspection
TEST_FLASHLIGHT_IMAGE_REFLECTION_CHECK.purpose: Distinguishes blown backlight driver from completely dead LCD/OLED panel by checking for faint liquid crystal ghosting.
prerequisites: Phone powered on in dark room
High-lumen flashlight held at 30° - 45° angle
safety_precautions: Applicable only to LCD panels; NOT valid for OLED/AMOLED screens which have no separate backlight
TEST_FLASHLIGHT_IMAGE_REFLECTION_CHECK.procedure: Hold flashlight at 30° - 45° angle directly against black display in darkened room.
TEST_FLASHLIGHT_IMAGE_REFLECTION_CHECK.expected_reading: Faint ghost graphics / clock / desktop icons visible under polarized illumination.
TEST_FLASHLIGHT_IMAGE_REFLECTION_CHECK.fail_condition: Completely blank liquid crystal matrix with zero polarization.

expected_observations.PASS: Faint desktop clock / wallpaper graphics visible under torch light. Backlight circuit is blown.
expected_observations.FAIL: Zero polarization or ghost image visible. Points to display assembly damage or OLED architecture.
expected_observations.INCONCLUSIVE: Severe glass reflection obscures screen surface.

TEST_FLASHLIGHT_IMAGE_REFLECTION_CHECK.rule_reference: TFT-LCD Illumination & LED Driver Failure Mode Standard §5.2

TEST_DIODE_MODE_BACKLIGHT_ANODE.name: Backlight Anode Power Rail Diode Reading
TEST_DIODE_MODE_BACKLIGHT_ANODE.purpose: Measures diode drop on display connector anode pin to identify shorted boost diodes or open series ferrite beads.
prerequisites: Battery disconnected
Display FPC cable unseated
Multimeter in Diode Mode (Red probe to ground)
safety_precautions: Do NOT probe anode rail when screen is connected and powered; boost voltage reaches 20V+ and will damage meter
TEST_DIODE_MODE_BACKLIGHT_ANODE.procedure: Probe Backlight Anode (BL_ANODE) pin on FPC display connector.
TEST_DIODE_MODE_BACKLIGHT_ANODE.fail_condition: 0.000V (anode filter shorted to ground) or OL (blown series ferrite bead).

expected_observations.PASS: 0.550V - 0.650V diode reading. Backlight anode circuit and boost filter are intact.
expected_observations.FAIL: 0.000V dead short or OL open line. Proves blown backlight diode, boost coil, or filter.
expected_observations.INCONCLUSIVE: Reading fluctuates due to loose probe contact.

TEST_DIODE_MODE_BACKLIGHT_ANODE.rule_reference: Mobile Backlight Driver Architecture & Boost Converter Diagnostics v1.8

TEST_DC_POWER_SUPPLY_BOOT_AMPERAGE.name: DC Bench Power Supply Boot Signature Waveform Analysis
TEST_DC_POWER_SUPPLY_BOOT_AMPERAGE.tool_required: Regulated DC Power Supply (0 - 30V, 0 - 5A) with Fast Milliammeter
TEST_DC_POWER_SUPPLY_BOOT_AMPERAGE.purpose: Analyzes dynamic current consumption during initial boot sequence to separate dead short, PMIC handshake failure, and CPU/RAM hang.
prerequisites: Battery uncoupled
OEM DC power supply boot cable hooked to battery connector
Voltage set to exactly 4.0V, current limit set to 2.0A
safety_precautions: Verify polarity carefully before switching on power supply; reversed polarity destroys PMIC immediately
TEST_DC_POWER_SUPPLY_BOOT_AMPERAGE.procedure: Connect boot cable to battery terminal, set voltage to 4.0V, press power button.
TEST_DC_POWER_SUPPLY_BOOT_AMPERAGE.fail_condition: Instant short before button press, or stuck at 80mA (RAM missing), or 180mA (NAND missing).

expected_observations.PASS: Dynamic current fluctuation between 60mA and 1.2A. Proves PMIC, AP, RAM, and NAND are executing code.
expected_observations.FAIL: Immediate 1.5A+ short before power button, or current freezes stubbornly at 80mA (RAM missing) / 180mA (NAND missing).
expected_observations.INCONCLUSIVE: Erratic current stepping that resets every 4 seconds.

TEST_DC_POWER_SUPPLY_BOOT_AMPERAGE.rule_reference: Mobile Power Management & AP Boot Signature Diagnostic Guide §7

TEST_MAINBOARD_FLEXION_PRESSURE_BOOT.name: Board Mechanical Flexion / Direct Pressure Test
TEST_MAINBOARD_FLEXION_PRESSURE_BOOT.purpose: Diagnoses micro-fractured solder ball joints under CPU/RAM BGA packages by testing if gentle physical compression restores connection.
prerequisites: Logic board mounted in testing jig or chassis with power attached
safety_precautions: Do not apply excessive force that could snap the multi-layer PCB internal copper vias
TEST_MAINBOARD_FLEXION_PRESSURE_BOOT.procedure: Apply light perpendicular pressure on CPU/RAM shield while triggering boot sequence.
TEST_MAINBOARD_FLEXION_PRESSURE_BOOT.expected_reading: Boot behavior is completely identical regardless of applied pressure.
TEST_MAINBOARD_FLEXION_PRESSURE_BOOT.fail_condition: Device boots or draws normal current ONLY while physical pressure is applied.

expected_observations.PASS: Device boots or draws normal current ONLY while physical pressure is applied to CPU/RAM shield, proving BGA fracture.
expected_observations.FAIL: Physical pressure produces zero difference in boot behavior; fault is purely electrical or firmware.

TEST_MAINBOARD_FLEXION_PRESSURE_BOOT.rule_reference: IPC-SM-785 Guidelines for Accelerated Reliability Testing of Surface Mount Solder Attachments

TEST_DFU_FASTBOOT_MODE_FLASH.name: Hardware USB Interface Handshake in Recovery/DFU/EDL Mode
TEST_DFU_FASTBOOT_MODE_FLASH.tool_required: Workstation PC with 3uTools / Odin / Fastboot CLI
TEST_DFU_FASTBOOT_MODE_FLASH.purpose: Determines whether low-level bootloader USB enumeration is intact, isolating software/firmware brick from BGA or power hardware failure.
prerequisites: Workstation PC with official USB drivers installed
Known-good data cable
safety_precautions: Ensure host workstation has uninterrupted power (UPS) to avoid corrupting bootloader during flash
TEST_DFU_FASTBOOT_MODE_FLASH.procedure: Hold key combo to force low-level bootloader mode, observe USB VID/PID enumeration.
TEST_DFU_FASTBOOT_MODE_FLASH.expected_reading: Clean USB enumeration with stable protocol handshake without disconnects.
TEST_DFU_FASTBOOT_MODE_FLASH.fail_condition: USB descriptor error, Error 4013 (NAND error), or random USB disconnect during flash.

expected_observations.PASS: Clean device enumeration in DFU/Fastboot mode; firmware flash succeeds completely without hardware error.
expected_observations.FAIL: Flash aborts with NAND Error 4013, Error 9, or unexpected USB bus reset indicating physical NAND/RAM failure.
expected_observations.INCONCLUSIVE: Device connects and immediately disconnects in loop.

TEST_DFU_FASTBOOT_MODE_FLASH.rule_reference: Mobile Firmware Deployment & NAND Flash Integrity Diagnostics §8

TEST_PANIC_LOG_ANALYSIS.name: Kernel Panic Crash Log Interrogation
TEST_PANIC_LOG_ANALYSIS.tool_required: Crash Log Analyzer / Log Reader Tool
TEST_PANIC_LOG_ANALYSIS.purpose: Parses kernel panic crash logs to pinpoint failing I2C sensor bus lines, thermal sensors, or watchdog timeouts.
prerequisites: Device capable of booting to OS or recovery diagnostic mode to dump logs
safety_precautions: Protect customer personal data in accordance with workshop privacy regulations
TEST_PANIC_LOG_ANALYSIS.procedure: Read panic.full or syslog crash dumps from crash log directory.
TEST_PANIC_LOG_ANALYSIS.expected_reading: Clean logs with zero missing hardware sensor watchdog timeouts.
TEST_PANIC_LOG_ANALYSIS.fail_condition: Panic string pointing to I2C sensor bus (e.g., prs0, mic1, gas_gauge, thermal_sensor).

expected_observations.PASS: Panic log identifies specific failing sensor line (e.g. thermal sensor or charging gas gauge) or pure OS crash.
expected_observations.FAIL: Logs indicate memory address translation fault (kernel panic watchdog) pointing to AP/RAM failure.

TEST_PANIC_LOG_ANALYSIS.rule_reference: POSIX / Darwin Kernel Panic Diagnostic Specification §6.1
